item.title: Version 0.8.7
item.description:
What's New

  • Settings › Advanced has a Share anonymous hardware info switch, off by default

Bug Fixes

  • Paused video wallpapers keep their color adjustments and wide-gamut colors after they sleep in the background
  • Choosing a Workshop scene or applying a scheme to a paused display starts it playing, the same as picking from the library
  • Wallpaper setups saved for disconnected displays are kept when one of them points to a missing file
  • Local web wallpapers whose file names contain % escapes load the right file
  • Pro: importing a package that contains a named pipe or other special file no longer hangs

Not notarized — if macOS refuses to open the app, run xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Loomscreen Pro.app" once; updates Loomscreen Pro installs itself clear the flag. Full release notes · 完整发布说明
